BETWEEN:-
 RAVI PAL S/O SHRI DESHRAJ PAL, AGED ABOUT 33  YEARS, OCCUPATION:

AGRICULTURIST RESIDENT OF  VILLAGE MADRI P.S. SENDRI DISTRICT NIWADI  (MADHYA PRADESH)
 
 (BY SHRI SUNIL KUMAR MISHRA-ADVOCATE)

AND  THE STATE OF MADHYA PRADESH THROUGH POLICE  STATION MAHILA THANA NIWADI DISTRICT NIWADI  (MADHYA PRADESH)
 ...
 (BY SHRI OM PRAKASH PATEL-PANEL LAWYER)
 This application coming on for admission this day, the co  following:

ORDER This is first application filed by the applicant under Section 439 of the Cr.P.C. for grant of regular bail relating to FIR No.08/2024 dated 07.02.2024 registered at Niwadi Women Police Station District-Niwadi (M.P.) for commission of offence under Sections 354, 354A, 506, 376 of IPC.

Applicant is in detention since 15.02.2024.
2.

As per the prosecution story, on 07.02.2024, 30 years old prosecutrix submitted an application in writing stating that on 04.02.2024 at around 05:00 p.m. she had gone out of the home to throw garbage.
When she was throwing garbage, Ravi Pal of the village came and attempted to outrage her modesty.
When she raised alarm, Ravi fled away from the spot.
F.I.R. was registered.
Almost after three days of the incident, prosecutrix's statement was recorded on 08.02.2024 before the learned J.M.F.C. and there prosecutrix improved the story and stated that she was raped.
After investigation, charge sheet has been filed.

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the applicant has submitted that applicant has not committed any offence.
He is innocent.
He has been falsely implicated.
Prosecutrix is a major lady.
She had lodged a false and concocted F.I.R. at the behest of her husband.
No such offence has taken place.
Therefore, it is prayed that the applicant may be released on bail.
4 . On the other hand, learned Panel Lawyer for the State has opposed grant of bail.
5 . Considering the overall facts and circumstances of the case but without expressing any opinion on the merit of the case, I am inclined to release the applicant on bail.
Consequently, this first bail application under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure for grant of bail filed on behalf of applicant, stands allowed.

6 . I t is directed that applicant - Ravi Pal be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court, for his regular appearance before the trial Court during trial with a condition that he shall remain present before the concerned Court on all the dates fixed by it during trial.

He shall abide by all the conditions enumerated under Section 437(3) of Cr.P.C.
7 .
This order shall be effective till the end of the trial.
However, in case o f bail jump and breach of any of the conditions of bail, it shall become ineffective.
Certified copy as per rules.
